usageNotes: Permanently removes an SDN IPAM object from the cluster-wide SDN configuration. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/ipams and the IPAM must not be referenced by any existing SDN zones or VNets before deletion. The API returns null synchronously; changes take effect after the SDN configuration is applied (use the SDN apply endpoint to push changes to nodes).

examples.summary: Delete a NetBox IPAM integration named 'netbox1'

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the IPAM object configuration from the cluster; any SDN zones relying on it for IP address management will lose their IPAM association and automatic IP allocation will stop working.
tips: Unlink the IPAM from all SDN zones before deleting — deletion of a referenced IPAM may be blocked or leave zones in a broken state.
Pass the lock-token if the SDN global config is currently locked by another operation to avoid a conflict error.
After deletion, call the SDN apply endpoint to propagate the removal to all cluster nodes.
